facts.title: audit finding - spot check of key safeguard at P-8302

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EXPOSURE_MONITORING: the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control LOAD_RESTRAINT_AND_PLACARDING: the restraint and placarding of transported loads had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the restraint and placarding of transported loads on P-8302 and M-8302 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in handling and dosing reagents, specifically making up, decanting and dosing reagents. P-8302 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 12 March 2008 a planned spot check of P-8302 and M-8302 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station found the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure not effective.
